name: GenerateExcuse
title: Generate Excuse
publisher: The Committee for Doing It Properly
description: Given a conformance requirement that was not met, returns an excuse from the accepted list. The operation is idempotent: the same requirement always produces the same excuse.

parameter.name: requirement
parameter.documentation: The key of the requirement that was not met.

parameter.name: deadline
parameter.documentation: When the next release is due, for calibration.

parameter.name: plausibility
parameter.documentation: How plausible the excuse is, from 0 to 1.
